post_calibration_recommended_generation.source_policy: never crop a multi-asset contact sheet into distinct approved states

release_checks: accepted source and normalized SHA256 with actual dimensions
Dropbox handoff bundle and per-asset file ID/revision/checksum receipts
separate Asset V2 registration/plan/status/doctor/ingest and runtime review
generation_protocol.correction_policy: correct or regenerate the same state without marking accepted; preserve rejected candidate identity; no guess-filled receipts
generation_protocol.restart_authority: read current GitHub planning ledger and reconcile actual Dropbox receipts and Asset V2 records; never trust a stale empty checkpoint as proof of absence
generation_protocol.alpha_screening_rule: For every transparency-requiring asset, report apparent transparency, visible matte/checkerboard, and uncertainty; claim true alpha only after byte-level inspection. CAL-01 opaque: alpha N/A.
generation_protocol.candidate_only_workflow_amendment: Automated core candidate pipeline: GENERATE_ASSET -> REVIEW_ASSET -> UPLOAD_ASSET_TO_DROPBOX to candidate-only lane. Verified candidate upload advances candidate cursor without human approval. Human approval, Asset V2, runtime cutover remain separate. Defer hard spatial blockers with exact IDs and revisit. 12 optional sources never automatic.

generation_sets_contract.selection: Candidate-only automation: select the earliest set (preserve order and exact asset_ids) lacking verified PASS_CANDIDATE staging for any required state, except documented DEFERRED_REQUIRED candidate blockers; do not lose or mark those deferred sets complete. Revisit deferred sets when their stated dependency changes. Production source approval uses a SEPARATE human review ledger and cannot advance assets into source_work/inbox without explicit per-image approval.
generation_sets_contract.generation_action: Generate only actual missing candidate image(s) in that set, each with its own stored prompt and independent image output. Do not merely propose what to draw; when image generator is available, invoke it. For multi-image sets use separate per-state calls, not n=2 same prompt or contact-sheet slicing.
generation_sets_contract.completion_predicate: CANDIDATE lane complete only when ALL 198 unique required core states have independent actual images, visual+objective PASS_CANDIDATE review, and verified candidate-only Dropbox file receipts. No required deferred states may remain. This NEVER means human source/production approval.
generation_sets_contract.pending_review_rule: A generated image with AI screening PENDING must be reviewed under REVIEW_ASSET; a failed image is regenerated under the SAME asset_id, not skipped. Once PASS_CANDIDATE and the candidate-only Dropbox file is verified (ID, revision, hash, path), candidate production may advance regardless of human_image_approval=pending. Human source approval never follows automatically.
generation_sets_contract.partial_set_rule: For each fixed set, produce/review/upload only missing candidate-staging states, each with its own independently addressable image. Set candidate completion means all its required asset IDs have valid verified staged PASS_CANDIDATE receipts. Do not infer production approval.
generation_sets_contract.blocked_set_rule: A true candidate-production blocker (missing geometry footprint, unregistered connector registration, necessary unavailable source or active-owner conflict) must be recorded as DEFERRED_REQUIRED with exact set ID, asset ID, reason and resolution owner. Keep it incomplete; the next eligible independent candidate set MAY proceed. Automatically revisit deferred required sets after upstream evidence changes; never report all-core complete while any deferred state remains.
generation_sets_contract.approval_rule: An individual human approval is still required for every production source and any Asset V2 ingest. AI PASS_CANDIDATE is exclusively candidate-only review and never artistic approval.
generation_sets_contract.tool_output_rule: For a grouped set of 2 states, generate two distinguishable independent source images in separate calls unless a tool can return independently identified per-prompt files; do not generate one composite grid. Reuse verified approved reference imagery if technically accessible; otherwise acknowledge limitation.
generation_sets_contract.optional_policy: 36 optional art states are fully specified but excluded from all 193 automatic candidate-generation sets until the user explicitly opts into specific optional family/state(s).
generation_sets_contract.when_all_complete: At 198/198 verified core candidates and no deferred required sources, declare candidate phase complete. Never automatically issue 36 optional source jobs, Asset V2 intake or deployment.
generation_sets_contract.prompt_source: assets[*].image_generation_prompt and state target/frame/alpha/anchor/consumer attributes; never substitute a generic scene prompt.
generation_sets_contract.checkpoint_authority: Use live origin/main plus actual source bytes, candidate staging file ID/revision/byte hash and stored candidate screening receipt. Candidate advancement and human-approved source advancement are separate independent cursors.
generation_sets_contract.current_initial_status: User-approved full-world V2 candidate contract: CAL-01 is verified PASS_CANDIDATE staged (source still unapproved); CAL-02 D6 384x576 true-RGBA eligible next. 198 required core, 36 optional, 193 fixed one-state sets.
generation_sets_contract.floor_first_rule: Flat ground-first sources, separate authorized true-alpha architecture/void/water scenery. CAL-01 is modular 512x512 floor material; CAL-02 is 384x576 D6-only true-alpha structure within existing nonwalkable D6; surrounding Hub B2 underlays are strictly floor-only, structurally separate. Gameplay/void masks/route access never owned by images.
generation_sets_contract.geometry_reconciliation: CAL-01 modular floor; CAL-02 384x576 true-RGBA D6 Root-choked Outer Arcade at (-1824,-4096), clipped to existing nonwalkable D6. Candidate screen and production source approvals remain separate.
generation_sets_contract.cal01_reference_gate: No approved paving V3 style anchor established. Unapproved reference studies may inform the creative brief only; actual supplied image inputs must be evidenced. Human CAL-01 approval remains pending.
generation_sets_contract.production_source_completion_predicate: All 198 required core states separately human-approved with immutable source master SHA and byte-level validated normalizations; Asset V2 registered/ingested and runtime presentation separately verified.
generation_sets_contract.codex_command_contract: Codex supplies ONLY one of these three command names, plus exact existing set_id and asset_id(s) from the current manifest. It does not issue plan/implement/unblock/merge actions in this artwork-production session. The assistant handles manifest reconciliation outside these commands. REVIEW_ASSET emits objective-versus-visual checks; UPLOAD_ASSET_TO_DROPBOX targets candidate_staging only after PASS_CANDIDATE and verifies file identity/revision/content; none of the commands grants human production approval.
generation_sets_contract.candidate_review_rubric: Actual image visual check plus independent byte-level format/dimensions/alpha requirements and real 3x3 repetition for seamless textures. A visual checkbox/label printed inside an image is not evidence; actual image bytes are required. For transparent assets report apparent alpha/matte/checkerboard separately from byte-level alpha verification.
generation_sets_contract.existing_set_id_stability: The 67 previous set IDs and all 72 legacy asset IDs are unchanged; their relative dispatch order is preserved, while 126 single-asset generation sets are inserted at logical phase boundaries and numeric order is reindexed for the complete roadmap.
